name: Gaba
overview: Gaba, also known as Geba, is identified in Scripture as a city of Canaan allotted to the tribe of Benjamin, highlighting its geographical and tribal significance in the land distribution described in Joshua 18:24. The city is mentioned alongside Ramah in the post-exilic records of Ezra 2:26 and Nehemiah 7:30, where the inhabitants of these towns are counted, reflecting the restoration of the community following the Babylonian exile. These references collectively underscore Gaba's role as a settled and recognized location within the biblical narrative of Israel's history.
